rollout.rollback_plan: Disable the Authority Gate and revert to observe stage if more than 3 false-positive deny events fire in any 24-hour window during the shadow rollout.

rationale: Twelve of eighteen observed prepare actions above 500 GBP fired with no active Authority Grant. The Authority Gate is the narrowest control: it requires an unrevoked grant for this agent + action pair, leaving every other agent on the pilot unaffected. Aligned to FCA SYSC 8 (outsourcing) and DORA Art. 17.
